title: MutualHandshakeMessages
description: AITP v0.3 Mutual Handshake payload schemas. Four message types: mutual_hello, mutual_hello_ack, mutual_commit, mutual_commit_ack. Commit payloads carry the peer's TCT (and optional grant voucher) as opaque compact JWS strings (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.5).

IdentityDescriptor.$comment: Mirror of schemas/json/aitp-identity.schema.json (RFC-AITP-0002 §1 names that file the canonical identity-descriptor schema). This $defs copy exists so the handshake schema stays self-contained — no schema in this repo resolves a cross-file $ref — and it MUST stay byte-equivalent to the canonical file minus its $schema/$id/title/examples metadata. scripts/check-doc-coherence.sh stage 5 enforces that; edit the canonical file and re-run `make validate` rather than editing this copy.
IdentityDescriptor.description: AITP v0.3 identity binding. Connects an AID to a verifiable issuer claim.

type.description: Identity mechanism. v0.3 supports: oidc, pinned_key, spiffe (RFC-AITP-0002 §6; registry status Proposed)

issuer.description: Issuer URI. Required for type=oidc; MUST be absent for type=pinned_key and type=spiffe (RFC-AITP-0002 §1, §6.1).

subject.description: Agent subject identifier. For type=spiffe: the SPIFFE ID of the workload, in canonical form (lowercase scheme and trust domain) with a non-root path (RFC-AITP-0002 §6.1).

proof.description: Verifiable proof. For type=oidc: a compact-serialized JWT (RFC-AITP-0002 §2). For type=pinned_key: a JCS-profile signature per RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3, Ed25519 or P-256 (a p256 sender MUST use the `p256.` tag; an untagged value is Ed25519), whose input binds sender AID, receiver AID, message_id, timestamp, and the handshake pop_nonce per RFC-AITP-0002 §3.1; the pop_nonce is sourced from the handshake envelope, not from this descriptor. For type=spiffe: with svid_type=jwt-svid, a compact-serialized JWT-SVID (RFC-AITP-0002 §6.3); with svid_type=x509-svid, a JCS-profile signature by the X509-SVID leaf key over the §6.4.1 input.

public_key.description: base64url public key in the RFC-AITP-0001 §5.3 AID-identifier form: 43 chars for Ed25519, 44 chars (SEC1 compressed point) for P-256. Required for pinned_key; forbidden for oidc and spiffe.

svid_type.description: SVID form carried in `proof` (RFC-AITP-0002 §6.1). Required for type=spiffe; forbidden for every other type.

x5c.description: X509-SVID certificate chain, leaf first, each entry a standard-base64 (RFC 4648 §4, padded) DER certificate (RFC 7517 §4.7 form). Required for svid_type=x509-svid; forbidden otherwise (RFC-AITP-0002 §6.4).

extensions.description: Optional extension namespace per RFC-AITP-0001 §7 and RFC-AITP-0012. Unknown keys inside `extensions` MUST be ignored; unknown fields outside it are rejected by this schema.

CompactJws.description: RFC 7515 compact JWS: exactly three non-empty unpadded-base64url segments. Embedded verbatim as an opaque string; the envelope layer never decodes or re-encodes it.

PopNonce.description: Random 128-bit value encoded as base64url (minimum 22 chars).

PopSignature.description: base64url(sign(private_key, sha256(peer_pop_nonce))). Proves possession of the private key for this agent's AID. MAY carry a v0.2 algorithm tag prefix (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3).

extensions.description: Optional extension namespace per RFC-AITP-0001 §7 and RFC-AITP-0012.

pop_nonce.description: Target's nonce. Initiator must sign this in MUTUAL_COMMIT.

pop_nonce_echo.description: MUST equal initiator's pop_nonce from MUTUAL_HELLO.

extensions.description: Optional extension namespace per RFC-AITP-0001 §7 and RFC-AITP-0012.

tct.description: TCT the initiator issues for the target — compact JWS, typ 'aitp-tct+jwt' (RFC-AITP-0005). Decoded claims validate against aitp-tct.schema.json.

grant_voucher.description: OPTIONAL grant voucher minted alongside the TCT — compact JWS, typ 'aitp-grant+jwt' (RFC-AITP-0005 §8). Omitted when issuer policy forbids the subject from delegating. Decoded claims validate against aitp-grant-voucher.schema.json.

pop_nonce_echo.description: MUST equal target's pop_nonce from MUTUAL_HELLO_ACK.

extensions.description: Optional extension namespace per RFC-AITP-0001 §7 and RFC-AITP-0012.

tct.description: TCT the target issues for the initiator — compact JWS, typ 'aitp-tct+jwt' (RFC-AITP-0005).

grant_voucher.description: OPTIONAL grant voucher minted alongside the TCT — compact JWS, typ 'aitp-grant+jwt' (RFC-AITP-0005 §8).

pop_nonce_echo.description: MUST equal initiator's pop_nonce from MUTUAL_HELLO.
